content:
With the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max starting $100 higher than their predecessors, Apple has applied the price increase across the entire iPhone lineup, including models that are completely unchanged.

This means the base iPhone 17 will now start at $899, up from $799. Likewise, the iPhone Air has officially crossed into four-figure territory, starting at $1,099.

The same $100 increase applies to the iPhone 17e and iPhone 16. The iPhone 17e has gone from its previous $599 starting price to $699.

Of course, this may give consumers pause — these iPhone models, which have been on the market for a year, are now more expensive despite no changes whatsoever.

However, Apple continues to adjust based on market conditions, such as rising component costs for items like RAM and storage, and the mere $100 increase is less than some analysts had originally anticipated.

Here is the full iPhone pricing following today's adjustments:

  • iPhone 17e: 256 GB for $699
  • iPhone 16: 128 GB for $799
  • iPhone 17: 256 GB for $899
  • iPhone Air: 256 GB for $1,099
  • iPhone 18 Pro: 256 GB for $1,199
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: 256 GB for $1,299
  • iPhone Duo: 256 GB for $1,999

With the arrival of the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 17 Pro has been discontinued. The base iPhone 17 is expected to be replaced by an iPhone in spring 2027.

Apple has split its release schedule, with only the new high-end models launching this fall, while base and Air updates are expected between March and April next year.
